title: Man in Black
syncedLyrics:
[00:06.51] Well, you wonder why
[00:07.96] I always dress in black
[00:11.88] Why you never see
[00:12.96] Bright colors on my back
[00:16.79] And why does my appearance
[00:19.37] Seem to have a somber tone?
[00:21.85] Well, there's a reason for the things
[00:23.88] That I have on
[00:27.04] I wear the black
[00:28.22] For the poor and the beaten down
[00:32.52] Livin' in the hopeless
[00:33.69] Hungry side of town
[00:37.07] I wear it for the prisoner
[00:39.65] Who has long paid for his crime
[00:42.16] But is there because
[00:43.35] He's a victim of the times
[00:47.34] I wear the black
[00:48.70] For those who've never read
[00:52.36] Or listened
[00:53.51] To the words that Jesus said
[00:57.37] About the road to happiness
[00:59.73] Through love and charity
[01:02.08] Why you'd think He's talking
[01:03.81] Straight to you and me
[01:07.04] Well, we're doin' mighty fine
[01:09.22] I do suppose
[01:12.21] In our streak of lightnin' cars
[01:14.57] And fancy clothes
[01:17.56] But just so we're reminded
[01:19.65] Of the ones who are held back
[01:22.41] Up front there ought to be
[01:24.47] A man in black
[01:27.62] I wear it
[01:28.89] For the sick and lonely old
[01:32.53] For the reckless ones
[01:33.82] Whose bad trip left them cold
[01:37.57] I wear the black in mournin'
[01:40.09] For the lives that could have been
[01:42.70] Each week we lose
[01:43.91] A hundred fine young men
[01:47.22] And, I wear it
[01:48.42] For the thousands who have died
[01:52.80] Believin' that the Lord
[01:54.69] Was on their side
[01:57.56] I wear it for another
[01:59.66] Hundred thousand who have died
[02:02.54] Believin' that we all
[02:04.41] Were on their side
[02:07.37] Well, there's things
[02:08.31] That never will be right, I know
[02:12.32] And things need changin'
[02:14.15] Everywhere you go
[02:17.54] But till we start to make a move
[02:20.11] To make a few things right
[02:22.55] You'll never see me
[02:24.08] Wear a suit of white
[02:27.03] Ah, I'd love to wear a rainbow
[02:29.97] Every day
[02:32.55] And tell the world
[02:33.89] That everything's okay
[02:37.22] But I'll try to carry off
[02:39.66] A little darkness on my back
[02:42.07] Till things are brighter
[02:44.05] I'm the man in black
[02:45.40]
plainLyrics:
Well, you wonder why
I always dress in black
Why you never see
Bright colors on my back
And why does my appearance
Seem to have a somber tone?
Well, there's a reason for the things
That I have on

I wear the black
For the poor and the beaten down
Livin' in the hopeless
Hungry side of town
I wear it for the prisoner
Who has long paid for his crime
But is there because
He's a victim of the times

I wear the black
For those who've never read
Or listened
To the words that Jesus said
About the road to happiness
Through love and charity
Why you'd think He's talking
Straight to you and me

Well, we're doin' mighty fine
I do suppose
In our streak of lightnin' cars
And fancy clothes
But just so we're reminded
Of the ones who are held back
Up front there ought to be
A man in black

I wear it
For the sick and lonely old
For the reckless ones
Whose bad trip left them cold
I wear the black in mournin'
For the lives that could have been
Each week we lose
A hundred fine young men

And, I wear it
For the thousands who have died
Believin' that the Lord
Was on their side
I wear it for another
Hundred thousand who have died
Believin' that we all
Were on their side

Well, there's things
That never will be right, I know
And things need changin'
Everywhere you go
But till we start to make a move
To make a few things right
You'll never see me
Wear a suit of white

Ah, I'd love to wear a rainbow
Every day
And tell the world
That everything's okay
But I'll try to carry off
A little darkness on my back
Till things are brighter
I'm the man in black
